fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (NASDAQ:SKHY) received an upward price target adjustment from $320 to $400 by Rosenblatt Securities analyst Kevin Cassidy (89% upside potential) while maintaining a buy rating, with more than half of 2027–2028 capacity already secured through long-term contracts, enabling expectations of substantial earnings and profit increases next year.
fields.summary_ko.1: Analysis indicates mint memory demand is independent of Nvidia management changes, and while the U.S. AI trade experienced its worst week amid political and inflation concerns, SK Hynix is viewed as the purest Korean exposure to Nvidia accelerator demand.
